template: Compare the three orthographic views against one another: work out the smallest number of cubes a gravity-supported structure could have while still producing all three, and decide whether those views pin down a single arrangement or whether some different arrangement could produce the same three silhouettes. State your conclusion, justify it by describing which view constrains which direction, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

deterministic_subfact_dependency_check.method: For every target sub-fact, test every 1-to-3-field subset of the other populated sub-facts. A relation is flagged when every repeated predictor tuple maps to one target and repeated tuples cover at least 80% of eligible rows. Explicit prohibited semantic identities remain validation failures.

minimum_cube_count.visual_signal: filled cells in the three rendered orthographic views
minimum_cube_count.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

uniqueness.visual_signal: compatibility of the three rendered silhouettes
uniqueness.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery
